ja: 移行が終わっただけでなく、テストも全部通った。
en: Not only did the migration finish, but every test passed.
alternatives: The migration finished, and every test passed too.
The migration finished, and on top of that every test passed.
point: Not only が文頭なら did the migration finish と倒置する

ja: 田中さんにレビューを頼みました。
en: I asked Tanaka to review it.
alternatives: I asked Tanaka for a review.
I asked Tanaka to do the review.
point: ask + 人 + to do。「頼む」の相手は ask のすぐ後ろに置く

ja: 設計の壁打ち相手が必要です。
en: I need someone to bounce this design off.
alternatives: I need someone to run this design by.
I need someone to talk this design over with.
I need someone to brainstorm this design with.
point: someone to + 動詞。off や with の前置詞を忘れずに

ja: ログインに、まだバグが一つあります。
en: There's still one login bug.
alternatives: We still have one login bug.
There's still one bug with the login.
point: 「〜がある」は There is で始める

ja: 誰かが環境変数を消したに違いありません。
en: Someone must have deleted an environment variable.
alternatives: Someone must have removed an environment variable.
Somebody must have deleted an environment variable.
point: 過去の確信ある推量は must have + 過去分詞

ja: 今日はドキュメントの仕上げに集中します。
en: Today I'll focus on finishing the docs.
alternatives: I'll focus on finishing the docs today.
Today I'm focusing on finishing the docs.
point: focus on の後は動名詞 finishing、to finish にしない

ja: あのバグ、私が今朝やっと突き止めました。
en: I finally tracked down that bug this morning.
alternatives: I finally pinned down that bug this morning.
I finally nailed that bug this morning.
point: 「突き止める」は track down。今朝は過去形

ja: 健太は今日、デプロイしなきゃ。
en: Kenta has to deploy today.
alternatives: Kenta needs to deploy today.
Kenta's got to deploy today.
point: 主語が三人称単数なので have to ではなく has to

ja: ケンは昨日、原因を突き止めましたか？
en: Did Ken find the cause yesterday?
alternatives: Did Ken figure out the cause yesterday?
Did Ken track down the cause yesterday?
point: 昨日のことなので Has ではなく Did で聞く

ja: 昨日マージしなければ、今は火消しをしていないのに。
en: If I hadn't merged yesterday, I wouldn't be firefighting now.
alternatives: Had I not merged yesterday, I wouldn't be firefighting now.
I wouldn't be firefighting now if I hadn't merged yesterday.
point: 過去の仮定+現在の結果は If+過去完了, would be ~ing

ja: 知っていれば、もっと早く共有したのに。
en: If I'd known, I would've shared it sooner.
alternatives: If I had known, I'd have shared it earlier.
I would have shared it sooner if I'd known.
point: If + had 過去分詞、would have 過去分詞 で過去の反対

ja: みんなでテスト結果を確認しましょう。
en: Let's all check the test results.
alternatives: Let's all review the test results.
Let's go over the test results together.
point: 「〜しましょう」は Let's の後に動詞の原形

ja: 誰かこのエラーの原因、分かりますか？
en: Does anyone know what's causing this error?
alternatives: Can anyone tell me what's causing this error?
Does anyone know why this error happens?
point: 疑問詞が主語のときは、Does anyone know の後ろもそのまま動詞が続く

ja: 佐藤さんがテストを直して、CI が速くなった。
en: Sato fixed the tests, speeding up our CI.
alternatives: Sato fixed the tests, which sped up our CI.
Sato fixed the tests, and our CI got faster.
point: 結果は、speeding up のように -ing で続けられる

ja: 彼女は三日間ずっと、この設定と格闘しています。
en: She's been wrestling with this config for three days.
alternatives: She's been struggling with this config for three days.
She's been fighting this config for three days.
point: 継続中の動作は has been -ing。期間は for

ja: インフラは昨日、DBを移行中でした。
en: Infra was migrating the database yesterday.
alternatives: Yesterday, infra was migrating the database.
Infra was busy migrating the database yesterday.
point: チームは単数扱いで was＋-ing の過去進行形

ja: 佐藤さんが直したと言ったバグ、まだ本番で起きてるよ。
en: The bug Sato said she'd fixed is still happening in production.
alternatives: The bug Sato said she fixed is still occurring in production.
That bug Sato said she'd fixed is still showing up in prod.
point: 主語は The bug Sato said she'd fixed で、動詞 is まで長い

ja: 今日30分、時間をもらえないかなと思って。
en: I was wondering if you'd spare thirty minutes today.
alternatives: Would you be able to spare thirty minutes today?
Do you think you could spare thirty minutes today?
I was wondering if I could get thirty minutes today.
point: 「〜もらえないかな」は I was wondering if you could/would

ja: 昨日のデプロイ、どこで止まりました？
en: Where did yesterday's deploy get stuck?
alternatives: Where did yesterday's deploy stop?
Where did yesterday's deploy stall?
Where did the deploy get stuck yesterday?
point: 過去の疑問なので did を使い、動詞は原形に戻す

ja: 今日は、昨日話したバグを直します。
en: Today I'll fix the bug we discussed.
alternatives: I'll fix the bug we talked about today.
Today I'm fixing the bug we talked about.
point: 「昨日話したバグ」は the bug we discussed と後ろから説明

ja: ログインの修正、もうレビューされた？
en: Has the login fix been reviewed yet?
alternatives: Has anyone reviewed the login fix yet?
Has the login fix been looked at yet?
point: 「もう〜された？」は yet 付きの Has been reviewed の形

ja: テスト終わったら、連絡します。
en: I'll message you when tests are done.
alternatives: I'll tell you when tests are done.
I'll let you know when tests finish.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形（are done）

ja: テストサーバー、まだ遅いです。
en: The test server's still slow.
alternatives: Our test server is still slow.
The test server still runs slow.
point: 「遅い」は形容詞なので be 動詞 is を忘れない

ja: 仕様は未定ですが、うちはフロントに着手します。
en: The spec isn't final, but we're starting front-end work.
alternatives: The spec isn't settled, but we'll start front-end work.
The spec isn't decided, but we'll begin front-end work.
point: 「未確定だが着手する」は but で対比させる

ja: あの設定、私が見落としたのかもしれません。
en: I may have missed that setting.
alternatives: Maybe I overlooked that setting.
I might have overlooked that setting.
point: 過去の推量は may have + 過去分詞

ja: うちは障害対応に追われて、ドキュメントに手が回ってない。
en: The outage swamped us, so we haven't gotten around to docs.
alternatives: The outage kept us busy, so we haven't touched the docs.
We've been tied up with the outage, so no docs yet.
point: 「まだ手を付けていない」は haven't gotten around to ~

ja: デプロイの失敗、もう私が直しました。
en: I've already fixed the deployment failure.
alternatives: I already fixed the failed deployment.
I've fixed the deploy failure already.
point: 「もう直した」は already と現在完了でよく使う

ja: 私はインターンにテストを書いてもらいます。
en: I'm having our intern write the tests.
alternatives: I'll have our intern write the tests.
I'm getting our intern to write the tests.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: ログインのバグを直しています。
en: I'm fixing the login bug.
alternatives: I'm working on the login bug.
I'm fixing the login bug now.
point: 今やっている作業は進行形 I'm fixing で言う

ja: 本番のログが見られません。
en: I can't see the production logs.
alternatives: I can't view the production logs.
I'm unable to see production logs.
point: 「見られない」は can't see。can't のあとは動詞の原形

ja: 昨日レビューを頼んでおけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd asked for a review yesterday.
alternatives: I should have asked for a review yesterday.
I wish I had asked someone to review it yesterday.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を過去完了 I'd asked にする

ja: 私が今日直すのは、ログインのバグです。
en: What I'll fix today is the login bug.
alternatives: The login bug is what I'll fix today.
What I'm fixing today is the login bug.
point: What で始めると「〜するのは」の文になる

ja: 明日の朝会、私は休んでもいいですか？
en: Is it okay if I skip tomorrow's standup?
alternatives: Would it be okay if I skipped tomorrow's standup?
May I skip tomorrow's standup?
Could I skip tomorrow's standup?
point: 許可を求めるときは Is it okay if I + 動詞の現在形

ja: 昨日直したバグが、また出ました。
en: The bug I fixed yesterday is back.
alternatives: The bug I fixed yesterday came back.
The bug I fixed yesterday has come back.
The bug I fixed yesterday is happening again.
point: 直した過去は fixed、今戻っている状態は現在形の is back

ja: 彼が昨日ロールバックしなかったら、今も障害中だよ。
en: If he hadn't rolled back, we'd still be down.
alternatives: If he hadn't rolled back yesterday, we'd still be down.
Without his rollback yesterday, we'd still be down.
point: 過去の仮定が今に影響: had + 過去分詞、would + 原形
